findings.highlight: this place is as big as a hotel
findings.evidenceJa: 旅館みたいに入り組んだ家
findings.governingReading: Rin suggests they passed each other because the house is as intricately laid out as an inn.
findings.explanation: An inn-like maze of corridors becomes a house as large as a hotel.

findings.highlight: was built with all kinds of passages and corridors
findings.evidenceJa: 無節操な改築によってあちこちに通路がある
findings.governingReading: The Emiya residence has corridors everywhere because it was expanded without a coherent plan.
findings.explanation: The house’s passages are attributed to original construction rather than haphazard renovations.

findings.highlight: were you in the bath so long that all your blood rushed to your head? Even your ears are bright red.
findings.evidenceJa: 湯にのぼせたのですか？　耳まで真っ赤ですが
findings.governingReading: She asks whether he is overheated or dizzy from the bath because even his ears are red.
findings.explanation: Saber infers that Shirou stayed in the bath too long and had blood rush to his head.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントにとって、性別など些末な事
findings.governingReading: She repeats that sex or gender is a trivial consideration for a Servant.
findings.explanation: Saber calling gender a minor matter for Servants becomes the absolute claim that gender is meaningless.

findings.highlight: you can do whatever you want with me.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの好きにしていい
findings.governingReading: He apologizes and tells Saber she may deal with the situation as she likes if it recurs.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s offer that Saber may do as she likes next time becomes permission to do anything “with me.”
